questions.why: Virgil Ovid Hawkins is a teenager from the city of Dakota.

questions.q: Static's stories are set in which fictional place?
questions.why: The original Milestone stories take place in Dakota.

questions.q: What kind of power does Static primarily command?
questions.why: Static generates electricity and magnetic fields, allowing force fields and flight on a metal disc.

questions.q: People who gained powers from the event that created Static are nicknamed what?
questions.why: The Big Bang dosed bystanders with a mutagen, creating the Bang Babies.

questions.q: In which year did the Static Shock animated series premiere?
questions.why: The show premiered on September 23, 2000, and ended in 2004.

questions.q: Who voices Static in the Static Shock animated series?
questions.why: Phil LaMarr voiced Virgil Hawkins throughout the series.

questions.q: In the Static Shock cartoon, Richie Foley becomes which hero in season 3?
questions.why: Static's best friend Richie Foley gains powers and becomes Gear.

questions.q: In which other Milestone comic did Static first appear in a three-page preview in 1993?
questions.why: A preview in Icon #1 introduced him a month before Static #1.

questions.q: On which broadcast block did Static Shock air?
questions.why: Static Shock aired on Kids' WB, the WB Television Network's children's block.

questions.q: Which artist co-founded Milestone Media and co-created Static with Dwayne McDuffie?
questions.why: Denys Cowan was among the founders of Milestone alongside McDuffie.
